𝐃𝐚𝐲 𝟐 of Vibe Coding -> AI Specialist Series
𝐁𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧-𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐲 𝐀𝐈 𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫 isn't about learning one framework. It's about mastering 𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐥𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐀𝐈 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐤, one step at a time.

Every response an 𝐋𝐋𝐌 𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐬 with predicting the 𝐧𝐞𝐱𝐭 𝐭𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐧. That single process powers everything from 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐛𝐨𝐭𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐀𝐈 𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬.

Behind every prompt is a sequence of steps that transforms your input into a coherent response.

Here's what happens every time you interact with an LLM.
💬 𝐈𝐧𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐭
Your instruction enters the model.
🔤 𝐓𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐧𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
The text is broken into smaller pieces called 𝐭𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐧𝐬.
🧩 𝐄𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬
Each token is converted into a numerical representation that captures its meaning.
📍 𝐏𝐨𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐜𝐨𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠
The model learns the order of the tokens so it understands context.
🧠 𝐒𝐞𝐥𝐟-𝐀𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
It identifies which words matter most and how they relate to one another.
🪟 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐱𝐭 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐰
The model focuses on the relevant information available within its context.
🎯 𝐍𝐞𝐱𝐭-𝐓𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐧 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
It predicts the most likely next token, one token at a time.
✅ 𝐎𝐮𝐭𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
Those predicted tokens become the response you read.

The biggest misconception about LLMs is that they're 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐡𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐬.
They're not.
They're continuously 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐞𝐱𝐭 𝐭𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐧 𝐬𝐨 𝐚𝐜𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐟𝐞𝐞𝐥𝐬 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭.

Once you understand this pipeline, many advanced AI concepts become much easier to understand.
➤ Why 𝐑𝐀𝐆 improves responses
➤ Why 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐱𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐬 matter
➤ Why 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐭 𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 works
➤ How 𝐀𝐈 𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬 plan and take actions

𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐬 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐭.
Everything else starts to click.
